# Billy Andrews

## Overview

- **Age:** Mid-to-late twenties
- **Gender:** Male
- **Status:** Alive
- **Origin:** Avonlea, Prince Edward Island, Canada
- **Role:** Farmer

## Appearance

Billy is described as a heavy, slow-moving young man with a round, cheerful face. He has fair hair and a rather plain, wholesome look. His physical presence reflects his easygoing and somewhat sluggish nature.

## Personality

Billy is extremely shy, good-natured, and quiet to a fault. He lacks conversational skill and often relies on his sister Jane to speak on his behalf. Though kind-hearted and dependable, he is completely straightforward, pragmatic, and utterly devoid of romance or imagination.

## Traits

- Extremely shy
- Quiet and dull
- Good-natured
- Practical

## Abilities

- Farming

## Goals

- To marry a sensible wife and run his farm successfully

## History

Billy grew up in Avonlea and attended the local school with Anne Shirley and her peers. As he reached adulthood, he settled into farming at the Andrews home. When he decided to propose marriage to Anne Shirley, his overwhelming shyness prevented him from doing so himself, leading him to ask his sister Jane to convey the proposal on his behalf. Anne promptly declined the proposal, much to her own relief and Billy's brief disappointment. Later, Billy married Nettie Blewett, a practical woman suited to his sensible lifestyle.

## Background by volume

- Grew up in Avonlea as part of the prominent Andrews family.
- Attended the Avonlea school alongside Anne Shirley and Diana Barry.

## Affiliations

- The Andrews Family — Son and brother
